name: role-render-convergence-admission
purpose: Prevent authenticated API success or a non-trivial generic HTML shell from being misclassified as proof that a role-specific UI is usable.
admission_rules: Each required role must exist in both the fresh-browser context proof and the later accessibility diagnostic.
A known generic-shell fingerprint may be observed during initial browser convergence, but it can never be accepted as the final role-ready state.
The final diagnostic must have at least one accessible interactive control and must report pass=true.
A screenshot timeout is diagnostic evidence, not by itself proof of a product defect; it becomes material when correlated with a generic shell or zero accessible controls.
API authentication, tenant binding and authorization success are necessary but are not sufficient proof of usable role rendering.
Role rendering must fail closed without weakening tenant, payroll, credential, provenance or autonomy controls.
